But a painting is stolen and he becomes the focus of suspicion!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Àtaidh agus Tilidh a’ gabhail norrag ann an taigh-samhraidh ùr Àtaidh, chan eil iad a’ dùsgadh far a bheil iad an dùil. Feumaidh Àtaidh na sgilean togail aige a chleachdadh airson faighinn dhachaigh. When Abney and Teal have a snooze in Abney's new summerhouse, they don't wake up where they expect. Abney must use his building skills to find the way home.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: 'S toigh le na h-Abadas a bhith a' seinn agus a' dannsa agus tha iad cho sona ri bròg nuair a tha iad a' cluinntinn gur e facal ceòlmhor a th'ann an diugh. Cò'n Abadas a thèid a thaghadh airson am facal a lorg agus dè seòrsa turas a bhios aca? The Abadas love to sing and dance and are delighted when they hear that the day's word is a musical one. Which Abada will be chosen to look for the word and will they have a 'furtastic' adventure?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair tha picnic rìoghail dol a ghabhail àite sa phàirc, tha Stella air a dearg nàrachadh, gun fhios nach fhaic a caraidean i an sin. Stella is really embarrassed in case friends see her when she is with her family at a royal picnic in the park.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royal Next Door
programme.desc: Nuair tha Partaidh nam Fiaclairean dol a thachairt, the Mrs Oh 'g iarraidh buidealair. Ach chan eil Mgr P deònach taic a thoirt seachad. Dè nì Stella is an Teaghlach Rìoghail airson cuideachadh leis a’ chuirm? When the Dentist Party is about to take place, Mrs Oh would like a butler. But Mr P isn’t prepared to help out. What will Stella and the Royal Family do to help at the event?

programme.title: Uaine
programme.desc: Thòisich tramaichean a’ ruith ann an Dùn Èideann ann an 2014 agus an-diugh tha faisg air 20,000 duine gan chleachdadh gach latha. The Calum agus a cho-ogha Ruairidh Iain anns a’ bhaile airson barrachd innse dhuinn mun deidhinn. Trams started running in Edinburgh in 2014 and now nearly 20,000 people use them every day. Calum and his cousin Ruairidh Iain visit the city to tell us a bit more about them.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: ‘S toigh le Valentin a bhith a’ farpais ri seòladairean eile. The e gu tur air a dhòigh air an uisge. ‘S e a mhiann coinneachadh ris a' churaidh, Armel le Cleac’h, seòladair a choisinn mòran dhuaisean aon-neach. Valentin loves to compete with other sailors and be on the water. His dream is to meet his hero, Armel le Cleac’h, a sailor who won a lot of solo trophies.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: After years of unhappiness, mill worker Mairead finally walks out of her decades-long marriage and into the arms of the person she loves - hotel owner Cairistiona. However, as the women agree to wait for the right time to tell Mairead’s husband Boyd they are together, little do they know there’s someone watching from the shadows. Às dèidh bliadhnaichean de mhì-thoileachas, tha neach-obrach na muilne, Mairead, a’ fàgail an duine aice às dèidh bliadhnaichean fada pòsta airson a bhith còmhla ris an neach air a bheil gaol aice – Cairistìona, aig a bheil an taigh-òsta. Ach, ged a tha na boireannaich agaontachadh feitheamh gus innse dha Boyd, an duine aig Mairead, gu bheil iad còmhla – ‘s beag a dh’fhios a th’ aca gu bheil cuideigin ‘san dorchadas gan coimhead. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Co-Sheirm
programme.desc: Sreath bhon tasglann a' taisbeanadh còisirean is guthan sònraichte. Anns a' phrògram seo, Còisir Ghàidhlig Lodainn. Archive music series showcasing choirs and outstanding soloists. This episode features The Lothian Gaelic Choir.

programme.title: Mach à Seo!
programme.desc: A trip to Ullapool and through the Coigach peninsula with Ramsay. Cuairt à Ulapul agus tro Rubha na Còigich le Ramsay.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the ‘Pretenders’, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Seumas & Innes or Liz Anne & Eilidh, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Seumas & Innes no Liz Anne & Eilidh, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr?

programme.title: Immigration Tracks
programme.desc: From Canada's Eastern province of Cape Breton, we embark on a road-trip east to Toronto, Ontario in search of Scottish Gaelic families who settled in this vast country over 100 years ago. Anne picks up the chanter in the Canadian capital, Ottawa, and goes in search of a relative who once farmed cattle in Bolton, Ontario. How do generations of Canadian Scots identify with their roots? Join Anne McAlpine on a cultural voyage of discovery. An t-seachdains, bidh Anne a’ feuchainn ri port a chluich air an fheadan ann am prìomh bhaile Chanada, Ottawa. Bidh Anne cuideachd a’ dol gu Bolton, Ontario is ceangal-teaghlaich aice ri fear a bha uair a’ cumail chruidh san àite.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2025 agus a’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Ímar, Larry Campbell & Teresa Williams, The East Pointers, Georgia Cécile agus Ainsley Hamill. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2025, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Ímar, Larry Campbell and Teresa Williams, The East Pointers, Georgia Cécile and Ainsley Hamill. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Tannadice '87
programme.desc: Tha 2017 a' comharrachadh an 30mh ceann-bliadhna bho rinn Dundee United FC rud a bha mòran dhaoine a' smaointinn a bha do-dheànta dhaibh: faighinn gu cuairt dheireannach Cupa UEFA. Tha Tannadice87 ag innse sgeulachd iongantach an iomairt Eòrpaich sin, bliadhna san do theab Dundè, a tha ainmeil airson silidh, diut agus naidheachdas, clach eile a chur air càrn urraim a' bhaile. 2017 marks the 30th anniversary of the year that Dundee United FC delivered on what many believed to be an impossible goal; reaching the final of the UEFA Cup. Tannadice '87 tells the remarkable story of this European adventure, a year in which dreams became reality, and Dundee, a city with a reputation for jam, jute and journalism added a fourth 'j' to its trademark: jubilation.

programme.title: Sgeulachd Cogaidh na h-Artaig/Untold Arctic Wars
programme.desc: The demand for intelligence is immense, and spy balloons and planes fill the northern skies.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by his daughter Ruth as they go to sea on a spectacular summer's day. Along the way they encounter a large pod of dolphins who take great delight in racing their small boat. Then it’s time for fishing and chat about the formative role of fishing in Ruth’s upbringing. Anns an dàrna prògram mu dheireadh san t-sreath, tha nighean Aonghais, Rut, còmhla ris agus iad aig muir air latha samhraidh eireachdail. Air an t-slighe, coinnichidh iad ri buidheann leumadairean-mara a tha dannsa mun eathar. Às dèidh sin, tha an t-àm ann airson iasgach agus còmhradh mun bhuaidh a bh’ aig iasgach air beatha Ruth.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Seata cuirme le Donnchadh Siosalach agus còmhlan-ciùil, clàraichte beò do luchd-èisteachd aig Duaisean nan Trads, 2023. A’ gabhail a-steach, Dizzy Blue agus A Precious Place. Concert set performed by Duncan Chisholm and band, originally recorded live before an audience at the Trad Awards, 2023. Featured tracks include Dizzy Blue and A Precious Place.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Là 1 aig Belladrum 2025 le Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air an t-seinneadair beothail, NATI. gu Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. Bho choisinn i cliù air TikTok aig àm a’ ghlasaidh, dhearbh an seinneadair-sgrìobhadair à Fìobha na comasan sgrìobhaidh aice le sreath de dh’òrain singilte. Tha i aithnichte airson a guth làidir le measgachadh sònraichte de cheòl folk, pop is rock. Day 1 at Belladrum 2025, and Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome the irrepressible singing star NATI. to the Hot House Stage. Since rising to prominence through TikTok during lockdown, the singer-songwriter from Fife has proved her songwriting talent with a series of hit singles and is known for her powerful vocals and unique blend of folk, pop and rock.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Simon Bates presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 6 May 1982. Featuring appearances from the Scottish and English World Cup squads, BA Robertson, Chas & Dave, Junior, Patrice Rushen, Tight Fit, Bananarama & Fun Boy Three and Paul McCartney & Stevie Wonder. Also including a dance performance from Zoo.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Andy Crane and Jenny Powell present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 4 May 1989 and featuring Edelweiss, Midnight Oil, Debbie Gibson, Bon Jovi, Roxette, Kylie Minogue, Poison, Live Report, Bangles and Chaka Khan.

programme.title: Whitney at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the hits of one of the greatest and biggest-selling stars of all time that looks back at Whitney Houston’s best performances at the BBC. This selection of songs, wrapped up in one of soul music’s biggest-ever voices, captures how the world sat up and listened when Whitney burst onto the scene in 1985 with Saving all My Love for You. Taking us on a journey, hit by hit, through the 80s, 90s and 00s, this playlist is an absolute must for all her fans, reminding us why audiences fell in love with her time and again, and why her early death in 2012 was such a tragic loss to the world of music.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: A look back at the life of the Oscar-winning actor Sir Anthony Hopkins. In interviews conducted with the BBC over the course of his career, we see him discuss his approach to acting, his hell-raising years and the famous films and roles that helped make him a star. They include Remains of the Day, Shadowlands, Nixon and, of course, The Silence of the Lambs, in which he first portrayed his most celebrated character, Dr Hannibal Lecter.

programme.title: Dusty
programme.desc: An edition of Dusty Springfield's 1960s variety show, first broadcast on 8 September 1966, with the voices of Madeline Bell, Lesley Duncan and Barbara Moore. Her special guests are American vocal quartet The Four Freshmen.

programme.title: Genius of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Historian Bettany Hughes embarks on an expedition to India, Greece and China on the trail of three giants of ancient philosophy: Buddha, Socrates and Confucius. All three physically travelled great distances philosophising as they went and drawing conclusions from their journeys. With Bettany as our guide, she gets under the skin of these three great minds and shines a light on the overlooked significance of the 5th century BC in shaping modern thought across the world. In this first episode, Bettany investigates the revolutionary ideas of the Buddha.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Simon Bates presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 6 May 1982. Featuring appearances from the Scottish and English World Cup squads, BA Robertson, Chas & Dave, Junior, Patrice Rushen, Tight Fit, Bananarama & Fun Boy Three and Paul McCartney & Stevie Wonder. Also including a dance performance from Zoo.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Andy Crane and Jenny Powell present the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 4 May 1989 and featuring Edelweiss, Midnight Oil, Debbie Gibson, Bon Jovi, Roxette, Kylie Minogue, Poison, Live Report, Bangles and Chaka Khan.

programme.title: Whitney at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the hits of one of the greatest and biggest-selling stars of all time that looks back at Whitney Houston’s best performances at the BBC. This selection of songs, wrapped up in one of soul music’s biggest-ever voices, captures how the world sat up and listened when Whitney burst onto the scene in 1985 with Saving all My Love for You. Taking us on a journey, hit by hit, through the 80s, 90s and 00s, this playlist is an absolute must for all her fans, reminding us why audiences fell in love with her time and again, and why her early death in 2012 was such a tragic loss to the world of music.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: A look back at the life of the Oscar-winning actor Sir Anthony Hopkins. In interviews conducted with the BBC over the course of his career, we see him discuss his approach to acting, his hell-raising years and the famous films and roles that helped make him a star. They include Remains of the Day, Shadowlands, Nixon and, of course, The Silence of the Lambs, in which he first portrayed his most celebrated character, Dr Hannibal Lecter.

programme.title: Tech Now
programme.desc: Andrew Rogers visits a former quarry where new tech is being tested to help people stay underwater for longer. Joe Tidy reports on a huge U-turn for big tech as Instagram stops end-to-end encryption. Franchesca Hashemi explains what you need to know about the lithium-ion batteries in the tech you use every day. And Nick Kwek meets the tech entrepreneur trying to decode animal language.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC.

programme.title: Clive Myrie’s Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive heads for the east coast of Barbados to check out the world’s oldest rum distillery. He explores the sugar cane fields and the factory floor before he gets the chance to have a sip of the golden produce. He puts a shift in with the hens on an organic family farm that stretches out for over 100 acres, tests out his flexibility alongside British expats with some cliff-top yoga and finally meets a young Bajan spoken word poet at the Builders of Barbados wall.

programme.title: What Happened at...?
programme.desc: The 1986 explosion at Chernobyl triggered a public health emergency across Europe. Today, the site's strategic location continues to be a flashpoint in Russia's war with Ukraine. Forty years on from the disaster, Jordan Dunbar travels to Chernobyl to examine the events that led to the world's worst nuclear accident and what we can learn from them today.

programme.title: BBC News

programme.title: The Media Show
programme.desc: Twenty years ago a man arriving for a job interview at BBC Television Centre was taken into a live TV studio and asked to comment on a legal story. The clip quickly spread on early video-sharing sites and became a meme. Guy Goma reflects on what happened, alongside Elliott Gotkine, the journalist involved in the original error. Saudi Arabia has spent large sums on sport and media in recent years, aiming to build influence as well as make financial returns. New developments, including changes to sports funding and involvement in major media deals, suggest a shift in approach. Claire Enders, founder of Enders Analysis, and Claire Atkinson, contributing editor at The Ankler and founder of Media Mix, outline how the strategy is changing. Climate change remains one of the most complex stories for news organisations to cover. It involves long-term change, scientific detail and questions about how to keep audiences engaged. David Shukman, journalist and former BBC Science Editor, sets out his view on how climate reporting has developed and the issues it faces.

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: Adventurer and UK Chief Scout Dwayne Fields continues his journey through Zambia. This time, he heads to the country's wild heart, to meet not just the animals but also their custodians, who are keen to share and preserve their country's precious assets. At Kafue National Park, he joins the hardy rangers taking their canine units out to track poachers, takes part in a lion-monitoring expedition and meets the orphaned elephants who are being prepared for release back into the wild.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek is hunting down his most terrific treks from the south. His first quest is an adventure between two captivating castles - Caerphilly and Castell Coch, where he gets the chance to don a full suit of armour. Next, Derek is in Gower walking from Fall Bay to Oxwich, where he discovers a mysterious clifftop hideaway and learns how this area used to be a haven for smugglers. On the way, he tries abseiling, cold-water swimming and foraging for seaweed. The last walk Derek remembers is in the wonderful Wye valley, where he marvels at one of the UK’s first tourist walks, takes to the water in a canoe and visits the awe-inspiring Tintern Abbey, where he witnesses the relics of a remarkable archaeological excavation.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Blankety Blank
programme.desc: The legendary Blankety Blank is back! Bradley Walsh hosts as a panel of six celebrities fill in the missing blanks and help win brilliant prizes for some very lucky contestants. This time, he’s joined by Julian Clary, Sophie Willan, Harry Pinero, Liza Tarbuck, Judi Love and Tom Allen.

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's Big Show
programme.desc: BAFTA Award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with his Big Show, filmed at London's prestigious Theatre Royal Drury Lane. Joe Lycett hands over his phone for a Send to All like no other, and an incredibly deserving Unexpected Star of the Show shares the stage with a mystery guest. Plus music from James Arthur, who performs a track from his latest album, and Michael takes his hit game show The Wheel on the road to surprise a family in Hull.

programme.title: The Weakest Link
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan returns as host of the Weakest Link, where eight celebrities’ general knowledge is put to the test, in order to bank as much money as possible for charity. Round by round the weakest link is voted off until the remaining two celebrities go head-to-head. Only one can win the prize pot for their charity. The celebrity contestants in this episode are Barry McGuigan, Karen Hauer, Joe Thomas, Elaine C Smith, Tomasz Schafernaker, Vikkstar, Katie Thistleton and Shivi Ramoutar.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: A Dalek fleet surrounds a lone rebel ship, and only the Doctor can help it now. With the Doctor facing his greatest enemy, he needs Clara by his side. Confronted with a decision that could change the Daleks forever, he is forced to examine his conscience and ask himself whether he is truly a good man.

programme.title: Doctor Who (2005–2022)
programme.desc: In a sun-dappled Sherwood Forest, the Doctor discovers an evil plan from beyond the stars and strikes up an unlikely alliance with Robin Hood. With all of Nottingham at stake, the Doctor must decide who is real and who is fake. Can impossible heroes actually exist?

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: While Button House is being fumigated for woodworm, Alison and Mike decide to save some money and camp in the grounds, sending the ghosts’ routines off kilter.

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Alison has invited Lucy to come to Button House for a sleepover, but after a worrying meeting with the solicitor, Alison must work out if Lucy is really who she says she is. The Captain insists on utilising his skills in surveillance to help Alison find out the truth, but is he really up to the job? As one by one the ghosts are charmed by Lucy’s character, Alison’s guilt over questioning her becomes tinged with jealousy. After an emailing prank by Julian gets out of hand, Mike has some awkward explaining to do to his boss, which Julian and Robin are gleeful to have front row seats for. Meanwhile, Lady Button is acting out of character, and the other ghosts are determined to find out why.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: Miranda has spent most of her life avoiding being set up by her mother Penny. Old school pal Tilly sets her up on a blind date with an army doctor friend, Dreamboat Charlie. The date doesn't go quite to plan and so Penny insists on throwing a party to introduce Miranda to a suitable man. Miranda is notoriously bad at coming up with excuses, but when she sees a photo of her intended date he is so bad that the only option left is to lie and come out to her mother in an attempt to stop her from matchmaking.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: When a handsome man leaves his wallet in the shop, Miranda and Stevie think it could be a sign, especially when they discover he's called Robert Husband. They become highly competitive and try to find out who he'd prefer to take to dinner if he had to choose one of them. Meanwhile, Tilly has invited Miranda to Henley Regatta under the strict proviso that she doesn't embarrass her. Miranda is determined to be able to cope at a tricky social occasion just once. Old friend Gary seems to be the only person who believes Miranda should just be herself. Gary, meanwhile, has been offered a new job in Hong Kong, but seems to be waiting for someone to persuade him to stay; will Miranda take the hint?

programme.title: Knocked Up
programme.desc: Rising journalist Alison Scott's career hits a serious bump in the road after a one-night stand with irresponsible slacker Ben Stone results in pregnancy. Rather than raise the baby on her own, she decides to give Ben a chance to prove he is father material. However, he is unsure if he is ready to be a parent, and both wonder if they would be compatible lifetime partners.

programme.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
programme.desc: Janet takes desperate action to stay safe for baby Corinthian. Gaz seeks a new friend who can replace Jonny. Louise consorts with the spirit world to persuade Janet to let her move in with her. Donna tries to get camp new bar manager Tim to come out.

programme.desc: A look at wildlife and conservation, visiting Edinburgh Zoo and meeting experts protecting endangered species and habitats for the future. John reflects on his lifelong passion for animals, sparked in early childhood, and how he overcame barriers and setbacks to pursue a career in conservation and education.

programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: In this special episode of Deadly 60, Steve Backshall takes a deep dive into the fate of one of the most extraordinary, and endangered, ecosystems on our planet: coral reefs. They may cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, but they support roughly a quarter of all marine life and are irreplaceable - yet they are in serious trouble. Steve travels to some of the world’s most celebrated reef systems, from the shallows of the Java Sea to the tropical waters of the Maldives. Along the way, he meets all the weird and wonderful creatures that call the reef home, including some of the best-camouflaged creatures and some impressive apex predators - he even gets a telling-off from a clownfish!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Set against the dramatic backdrop of the Malvern Hills, Gardeners’ World comes from the spectacular RHS Malvern Spring Festival in Worcestershire. Rachel de Thame and Joe Swift share everything the show has to offer. Gardens, plants and expert advice, as well as tips and tricks to try at home – no matter the amount of outdoor space. There’s a visit to the Devon-Somerset border to meet a grower who, with the help of a couple of feathered friends, has transformed a woodland landscape into a stunning nursery for the humble hosta. After a drastic career change to follow her dream, one designer explains why she is using her first show to demonstrate the art of pressing flowers. There’s also a time travel visit back to the 1970s for a houseplant fanatic who’s taken her inspiration from her grandmother’s house. It’s a spring celebration not to be missed!

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) is a free-spirited young socialite whose fortune suddenly changes when she is diagnosed with a brain tumour. Kindly Dr Fredrik Steele (George Brent) takes charge of her care and the two grow increasingly fond of each other. But Judith's negative prognosis casts a shadow over their romance, as she must prepare to face the worst.

programme.title: Now, Voyager
programme.desc: Heartwrenching drama about a repressed woman's struggles to break free from her overbearing mother and assert her independence. On the advice of a skilled psychiatrist, she embarks on a cruise, during which she finds love and self-esteem for the first time in her life. But her newfound confidence is shaken when it is revealed her beau is a married man.

programme.title: Women's Six Nations Rugby
programme.desc: The penultimate weekend’s fixtures kick-off at the Stadio Sergio Lanfranchi in Parma as England meet Italy.

programme.title: Women's Six Nations Rugby
programme.desc: Coverage from the Hive Stadium as Scotland take on France in the Women's Six Nations.

programme.title: Maggie Smith at the BBC
programme.desc: Celia Imrie narrates a celebration of the life, work and TV appearances made over the years by one of Britain’s greatest and best-loved acting icons, Dame Maggie Smith. Alongside new memories of Maggie from long-standing friends like Judi Dench and Derek Jacobi are a rich selection of classic clips from the 1960s to the 2020s, all demonstrating her wit, wisdom and unique ability to leave interviewers and audiences shaking with laughter but also in fear of being skewered by that famously sharp tongue.

programme.title: The Miracle Club
programme.desc: Dublin, 1967. The lure of Lourdes sees three wives and a prodigal daughter facing up to past actions and present fears on the trip of a lifetime.

programme.title: Simply Red at the BBC
programme.desc: Simply Red became one of the UK's biggest and most successful bands of the 80s and 90s, thanks to a string of modern soul classics and covers built around the unique voice of frontman Mick Hucknall. Here, the best of their long list of hits are captured in a collection of performances from the BBC's music archives that demonstrate exactly why Hucknall merits his reputation as one of the greatest vocalists of recent decades. Amongst the many songs being showcased here are much-loved favourites like Stars, Holding Back the Years and Something Got Me Started, alongside some of the band's most popular covers, including Money's Too Tight (To Mention), Every Time We Say Goodbye and If You Don't Know Me by Now.

programme.title: 40 Years of Simply Red: Holding Back the Years
programme.desc: Celebrating 40 years of Simply Red, this concert film captures Simply Red’s electrifying performance at the Arena Santiago in Chile. The band played five consecutive sold-out shows to rapturous audiences as part of their Latin American tour leg, which saw them perform to over 140,000 fans. Featuring stunning performances of Simply Red's greatest hits and fan favourites spanning their entire career – from their critically acclaimed debut Picture Book right through to their latest releases.

programme.title: The Producers
programme.desc: A struggling producer and timid accountant scheme to make money by putting on a Broadway show they know will flop, so none of the numerous investors will expect their cash back. A tasteless glorification of Hitler and the Nazis looks guaranteed to fail.

programme.desc: In this special episode of Deadly 60, Steve Backshall takes a deep dive into the fate of one of the most extraordinary, and endangered, ecosystems on our planet: coral reefs. They may cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, but they support roughly a quarter of all marine life and are irreplaceable - yet they are in serious trouble. Steve travels to some of the world’s most celebrated reef systems, from the shallows of the Java Sea to the tropical waters of the Maldives. Along the way, he meets all the weird and wonderful creatures that call the reef home, including some of the best-camouflaged creatures and some impressive apex predators - he even gets a telling-off from a clownfish!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Set against the dramatic backdrop of the Malvern Hills, Gardeners’ World comes from the spectacular RHS Malvern Spring Festival in Worcestershire. Rachel de Thame and Joe Swift share everything the show has to offer. Gardens, plants and expert advice, as well as tips and tricks to try at home – no matter the amount of outdoor space. There’s a visit to the Devon-Somerset border to meet a grower who, with the help of a couple of feathered friends, has transformed a woodland landscape into a stunning nursery for the humble hosta. After a drastic career change to follow her dream, one designer explains why she is using her first show to demonstrate the art of pressing flowers. There’s also a time travel visit back to the 1970s for a houseplant fanatic who’s taken her inspiration from her grandmother’s house. It’s a spring celebration not to be missed!

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) is a free-spirited young socialite whose fortune suddenly changes when she is diagnosed with a brain tumour. But Judith's negative prognosis casts a shadow over their romance, as she must prepare to face the worst.

programme.title: Maggie Smith at the BBC

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: In this special episode of Deadly 60, Steve Backshall takes a deep dive into the fate of one of the most extraordinary, and endangered, ecosystems on our planet: coral reefs. They may cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, but they support roughly a quarter of all marine life and are irreplaceable - yet they are in serious trouble. Steve travels to some of the world’s most celebrated reef systems, from the shallows of the Java Sea to the tropical waters of the Maldives. Along the way, he meets all the weird and wonderful creatures that call the reef home, including some of the best-camouflaged creatures and some impressive apex predators - he even gets a telling-off from a clownfish!

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Set against the dramatic backdrop of the Malvern Hills, Gardeners’ World comes from the spectacular RHS Malvern Spring Festival in Worcestershire. Rachel de Thame and Joe Swift share everything the show has to offer. Gardens, plants and expert advice, as well as tips and tricks to try at home – no matter the amount of outdoor space. There’s a visit to the Devon-Somerset border to meet a grower who, with the help of a couple of feathered friends, has transformed a woodland landscape into a stunning nursery for the humble hosta. After a drastic career change to follow her dream, one designer explains why she is using her first show to demonstrate the art of pressing flowers. There’s also a time travel visit back to the 1970s for a houseplant fanatic who’s taken her inspiration from her grandmother’s house. It’s a spring celebration not to be missed!

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) is a free-spirited young socialite whose fortune suddenly changes when she is diagnosed with a brain tumour. Kindly Dr Fredrik Steele (George Brent) takes charge of her care and the two grow increasingly fond of each other. But Judith's negative prognosis casts a shadow over their romance, as she must prepare to face the worst.

programme.title: Now, Voyager

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the high-stakes quiz, joined by a celebrity team featuring comedian and actor Charlie Brooks, Dr Amir Khan, presenter Sara Damergi and comedian Tim Vine as they take on the Bridge of Lies in support of their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each Bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Simply Red at the BBC
programme.desc: Simply Red became one of the UK's biggest and most successful bands of the 80s and 90s, thanks to a string of modern soul classics and covers built around the unique voice of frontman Mick Hucknall. Here, the best of their long list of hits are captured in a collection of performances from the BBC's music archives that demonstrate exactly why Hucknall merits his reputation as one of the greatest vocalists of recent decades. Amongst the many songs being showcased here are much-loved favourites like Stars, Holding Back the Years and Something Got Me Started, alongside some of the band's most popular covers, including Money's Too Tight (To Mention), Every Time We Say Goodbye and If You Don't Know Me by Now.

programme.title: Maggie Smith at the BBC
programme.desc: Celia Imrie narrates a celebration of the life, work and TV appearances made over the years by one of Britain’s greatest and best-loved acting icons, Dame Maggie Smith. Alongside new memories of Maggie from long-standing friends like Judi Dench and Derek Jacobi are a rich selection of classic clips from the 1960s to the 2020s, all demonstrating her wit, wisdom and unique ability to leave interviewers and audiences shaking with laughter but also in fear of being skewered by that famously sharp tongue.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Zola shrinks cars. Rhino learns about the tooth fairy.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Tweak and Bud find themselves stranded on a floating island made of papyrus reeds.

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stanley and a Can-Bot are helping Hettie host a museum sleepover for the kids. But on a special treasure hunt, an ancient wheel rolls off its plinth, and Stan has to work out how to stop it.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea tricks Supertato and the Veggies, who fall into the deli counter and come face to face with the Turnip of Terror. They escape with help from the not-so-scary Turnip.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Ginger goes on his first official mission with the Peak City Heroes.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. In this song inspired by the Beach Boys, the Small Potatoes enjoy playtime after school and every day.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca and Murphi are dealing with a glut of carrots from the vegetable patch, and they have made everything from carrot cake to carrot juice. This inspires Murphi’s first idea – a carton bunny rabbit. The Mini Monsters are making colourful caterpillars, and Rebecca’s uncle is snug as a bug in his woolly cardigan when he calls her on the Magic Monster Mirror. The Recycling Express brings an empty box, which Rebecca and Murphi transform into a cardboard kitty cat.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen is playing with her toy train set, but she really wants to go on a real steam train. Tess the train driver comes to visit, Small flies off to see how leeks grow, and they make a choo-choo party platter for their special guest.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to the park to feed the birds at the pond. On the way, they race like racing cars, spot the different coloured flowers, listen to the thunder and even meet a Stick Man tree!

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum jumps to conclusions when he hears about an upcoming volcanic eruption. But little does he know, it's Ava’s science project that’s set to fizzle in a safe experiment.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels decide to play football. Duggee starts the game by kicking the ball to the Squirrels, who look at it blankly. They don't know what to do - they've never played football before. Worm, Hennie and Ethel do their best to show them the rules, but it's all going in the wrong direction. How will they ever score a goal?

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida is used to being the vet, but when she hurts her ankle while making house calls, she becomes the patient and all of Sweetwood helps out!

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Animated adventure comedy series. The team dives into action as Glitch's treasure hunt endangers the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Dash and Jake set off on a camping adventure, determined to stick to their wizarding scout plan - no wishes allowed! When they realise the original plan won’t work, Rafi suggests making a new one instead. With teamwork, flexibility and the right wish, the Wizard Wagon takes flight and carries them to the perfect camping spot at sunset. Rafi learns that plans can change, and sometimes the best adventures come from making a new one together.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Twinkle discovers an army of marching ants taking seeds from her vegetable garden. When all attempts to stop them fail, can she and Yukee find a way to get the ants marching to a different beat and away from her garden?

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s the exceptional painter Spinach creating Kiwi’s portrait, if Kiwi can keep still.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends go up, up, up and away having fun playing aeroplanes. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble turns his home into a hotel and has some very important guests flying in.

programme.title: The Toddler Club
programme.desc: Gemma, Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear welcome toddlers Suuvi, Jasper, Sammie, Teddy and Tehlani, and their grown-ups, to the Toddler Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! The What’s in the Box? game reveals a stacking shape sorter, and when the toddlers and parents open up a bigger box, they discover lots more objects and toys that are inspired by sorting and matching. This theme is explored through play, song and story. Grown-ups are encouraged to take part at home by hiding a safe, toddler-appropriate sorting and matching toy or object inside a recycled box for them to reveal and explore with their toddler! Storytime is all about fun and playful discovery, as the Toddler Twins’ friend Fox tries to sort out the washing that’s hung on the line. But someone is being cheeky and stealing Fox’s socks! Will Fox find out who? Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring the sorting and matching theme too. And, The Toddler Club Bop gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with stretching and the Goodbye song.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou have a big fight but find it’s too hard not to be friends.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Fred and Dana come up with a new celebration - the Fine Forest Happy Helpers Day! They ask the Piggies to build a throne while baking a pie. Meanwhile, Wilf is determined to be rewarded and asks the Piggies for the impossible: to teach him how to help others.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Iona and Elba make bird feeders as a present for their Nanny Pip and Gramps, who they are visiting. They place the feeders around the garden and wait patiently for birds to arrive, hoping they’ll discover the tasty treats. Back home, the sisters dress up their teddy as an astronaut and turn Mum and Dad into space aliens! Then it’s ‘blast off’ as they go on a make-believe mission into outer space to rescue teddy’s lost rocket ship. But will they find it? And are those aliens friendly?

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stanley and a Can-Bot are helping Hettie host a museum sleepover for the kids. But on a special treasure hunt, an ancient wheel rolls off its plinth, and Stan has to work out how to stop it.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers land on an ancient Greece planet, where they learn to play jump the rubber band. But Kate is pretending to be a director, and her friends think she is very fussy! Thankfully, she’s interrupted when a local spider needs help filming for a contest.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Pea-Rexes find a stinky flower. The smell transfers to Wasabi, who hates baths.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: An excitable Red arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour red with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It's picnic day! Rebecca and Murphi create a 'soup-er' fly in a bowl of soup. On the Recycling Express, an old storage tub becomes a totally terrific tub drum kit.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Kranium lures people to a party in Peak City with the promise of a giant birthday cake.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers make pumpkin lanterns while learning why using all of the parts of a pumpkin is important for the environment. They use the dried pumpkin seeds to feed the birds and add the extra scraps to the compost to help garden flowers to grow.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is tracking all the dinosaurs on Dino Island to find out when they move from one part of the island to another in search of food or shelter. She asks Andy to find a herd of triceratops and place one of her tracking devices on them. Heading out on an epic adventure, Andy finds a lost baby triceratops, who has become separated from its family because of a thorn in its foot. Andy sets about removing the painful thorn, then reunites the baby with its family, before finally completing his important mission.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Raisin is planning a Button Exhibition and asks Supertato to look after her most precious button, Princess Bella Bob. She has put a confetti surprise in its box for the grand opening. Evil Pea plans to take the button to ruin Supertato’s reputation.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and a group of deaf and hearing children meet in Tall Trees Forest to make cheeky pop-up weasel puppets, then they sing and sign Pop Goes the Weasel, learning the signs for rice and weasel.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger discovers some unexpected guests hiding in her tail - three baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: With help from some kittens, Nick and the Popcasters put on a big concert at the old town hall for two very special mums.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Tidbit sprains his ankles before performing, so Fergie teaches him wheelchair dance moves.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Big Lizard is jealous of the vacuum cleaner and hides it from Dad and Cosima. Ammon decides it's her new best friend, whilst Cosima reassures Big Lizard that he will always be her BFF.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wants to blow a bubble just like her dads, but no matter how hard she tries, it won’t work. She makes a wish and creates a huge, magical bubble that floats around the park. As Rafi chases after it, the bubble spreads wonder wherever it goes. But when the bubble finally pops, Rafi is heartbroken. With help from her dads and friends, Rafi realises that bubbles aren’t meant to last forever, and that some of the most special moments are wonderful because they are fleeting.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck dress up as each other and decide to perform a play!

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Charlie loves his little sister Lola, even if at times she lets her imagination run away with her. Lola's red shiny shoes no longer fit, and Dad insists that she gets a new pair. Lola is not having any of it - her old red shiny shoes are her favourite, and she is definitely not going to change them, not ever. After she tries on hundreds of other shoes, Dad buys her brown shoes with big buckles.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion is very pleased that his best friend Dibillo wants to visit his bridge for tea. Mr Onion waits patiently for his best friend - but where is Dibillo?

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo uses a GoGo Brick to help BaBa see a caterpillar. At Play Time, BaBa uses a GoGo Brick to place the last piece on top of a tower. At Yummy Time, MeMo and BaBa help the Yummies pick a tomato, and on the Lullaby Lake, Fungi and Pungi help MeMo and BaBa travel to the Bay of Books in the GoGo Boat, where Gramma Leeba is waiting for them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy and Igglepiggle go for a walk in the garden on a very windy day. The trees blow from side to side. Igglepiggle's blanket gets blown up and up into the air - where will it land? The Tombliboos are outside their house and their trousers have blown off the line - all round the garden and onto the roof of their house.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Musician Joe Talbot reads a Bedtime Story celebrating love.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red and Yellow meet new arrival Orange. Discover what happens when you mix red and yellow.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona turns bird detective and learns all about seagull behaviour.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco is showing Bing how magnets work. While Coco builds a tower, Bing wants to find more magnetic things. In the garden he tests the ball, table and key, announcing which are magnetic. When Bing tries the watering can, he accidentally drops the magnet behind the flowerbed! Neither Bing nor Coco can reach it, so Flop shows them how to fish with magnets.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: ­Rain is forecast in Fluffytown, but Love Monster is excited because his friends are coming round for an indoor activity day. They're going to knit onesies, drink hot chocolate and build a pillow fort! But when the weather turns out to be glorious, Love Monster's friends want to play outside instead. Eventually Love Monster is convinced to join them but when he does, it rains! Disappointed, his friends start to head back inside, but Love Monster says they can do his indoor activities outdoors!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The full moon makes Wilf howl all night! The next morning, everyone is exhausted - and there’s a boulder blocking Brian’s door! He’s the only one who knows how to stop Wilf’s howling, so they need to budge that boulder.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: When Wasabi injures his leg, Ginger and the Peas are forced to wait on him hand and foot.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s tiny Brussels Sprout performing I’m Mighty and proving how great he is.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Bryan gets spooked and thinks there’s a lake monster lurking in the mists. It’ll be Mojo and Bo who have to find the monster... or show Bryan that there’s no monster at all!

programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: With Hodge’s radiator broken and no way to order another one, Brewster turns out to be the only one that can help by making a brave decision.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: During the Veggies' Super Sidekick Costume Contest, Evil Pea traps Supertato in a jar of honey. All is lost until the Veggies become real super sidekicks, the Tato Team!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'Eggy got broken and I didn't want that to happen.' At Amma's creche the children make eggy heads with egg shells and cress seeds. Bing knows his Eggy needs water, light and time before it can grow 'hair' but waiting is hard. He tries to speed up the process by giving Eggy lots of water with the garden hose.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Coco want to read Charlie a story. Bing wants to read Biteysaurus's Big Book of Dinosaurs, and Coco wants to read The Rainbow Fairy Mice and the Disappointed Dragon. Bing's book is first, but when Coco tries to bring the Rainbow Fairy Mice into the story, Bing is frustrated – that's not how it goes! But Flop shows Bing how they can combine the two tales together.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee has written a list of activities for the Squirrels to do, but he’s misplaced the piece of paper! Excited for the day, the Squirrels offer their help. First, they learn what a list is – it is the things you need to do written on paper. The Squirrels think that they can recreate Duggee’s list, so they begin to suggest activities, but these end up just being what they want to do. They are encouraged to continue playing and ticking off the activities they want to do; they hunt for treasure, try new things and play dress up together! Only when they’ve finished their list do they realise where Duggee’s one was all along… and they’ve been helping him tick his off without knowing!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels have made a song. They enjoy playing for others but wish they had a chance to see how they perform together. Duggee explains that they can if they make a music video, which tells a story. There is a lot to prepare beforehand, such as lights, costumes and glitter, and as they prepare, we are immersed into Enid’s dream, where she gives a star performance in her own eclectic music video! The Squirrels are taught to practice their dance moves before filming, to pick the perfect location and to try and put something unexpected into the video. After lots of collaboration, creativity and fun, the Squirrels finally get to watch their own music video and are thrilled at the results.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Xuli, Foz and the cadets have travelled to a small island near the Academy for some birdwatching. But when an electrical storm strikes the Academy, they end up stranded! Back in the library, Glitch and Kyan have to use their ingenuity to break out and help the others.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter finds a mysterious key hidden in his father's journal and is determined to find out what it fits. But his insatiable curiosity leads him into Mr Tod's lair and a trap!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers for more deep sea adventures. The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick before hungry predators do.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Vida’s vet bag goes missing, it’s up to her and her Sweetwoodian friends to track it down. Not only do they find it, but they also discover a hermit crab in need of a new home!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo join the big cross-town race with plans to win. But how can they stay ahead when they have to keep stopping and swopping to help other racers in trouble?

programme.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
programme.desc: Look out, it's coming for our quads! In the colossal Quadzilla Challenge, we do peekaboos, knee smashers and kickers. Our last stand against the giant Quadzilla is the Activate! Get those quads ready to move with Joe and the Activators.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble goes on a surprise bus journey with his family, while Justin and his friends go on a boat adventure!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It’s lunchtime on Bluey’s back deck! But every BBQ needs a side salad, so Bingo’s relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum/pepper her cousins ask for!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up at the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown. He puts on a magic show for the Squirrels, making things appear and disappear to enthusiastic requests.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn’t always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn’t know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Volcanic smoke blocks the three Proximan suns, which causes Big Lizard to become worryingly cold. Cosima's on the case and comes up with a superhot solution!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger races the Baby Pea-Rexes around Vegesaur Valley to the water hole.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Lars sees a mysterious creature near the Academy jungle and rushes to tell the others. Ubercorn explains that new species are discovered all the time, so this could be something that no one has seen before. He also tells them that new species are often named after the person who finds them. Excited by the prospect of lending their name to this mysterious creature, the Go Jetters, Grandmaster Glitch and Tala head out on a jungle expedition - but something seems to be watching them from the treetops...

As Rafi chases after it, the bubble spreads wonder wherever it goes. But when the bubble finally pops, Rafi is heartbroken. With help from her dads and friends, Rafi realises that bubbles aren’t meant to last forever, and that some of the most special moments are wonderful because they are fleeting.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck dress up as each other and decide to perform a play!

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Charlie loves his little sister Lola, even if at times she lets her imagination run away with her. Lola's red shiny shoes no longer fit, and Dad insists that she gets a new pair. Lola is not having any of it - her old red shiny shoes are her favourite, and she is definitely not going to change them, not ever. After she tries on hundreds of other shoes, Dad buys her brown shoes with big buckles.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion is very pleased that his best friend Dibillo wants to visit his bridge for tea. Mr Onion waits patiently for his best friend - but where is Dibillo?

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo uses a GoGo Brick to help BaBa see a caterpillar. At Play Time, BaBa uses a GoGo Brick to place the last piece on top of a tower. At Yummy Time, MeMo and BaBa help the Yummies pick a tomato, and on the Lullaby Lake, Fungi and Pungi help MeMo and BaBa travel to the Bay of Books in the GoGo Boat, where Gramma Leeba is waiting for them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy and Igglepiggle go for a walk in the garden on a very windy day. The trees blow from side to side. Igglepiggle's blanket gets blown up and up into the air - where will it land? The Tombliboos are outside their house and their trousers have blown off the line - all round the garden and onto the roof of their house.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

True feelings about neighbours' game-play surface, leaving tensions high between two neighbours... The households head into their fourth removal, where they all have some big decisions to make. Will friendships endure?

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. True feelings about neighbours' game-play surface, leaving tensions high between two neighbours... The households head into their fourth removal, where they all have some big decisions to make. Will friendships endure?

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary's culinary adventure takes him west to Ballycastle, a former Viking settlement and a jewel of the Causeway Coastal Route. With Rathlin Island on the horizon, Dermot heads out on a wildlife-watching trip, spotting seabirds and seals while uncovering the area's rich history. Back on shore and hungry from the sea air, he joins bakers Ciara and Dara at Ursa Minor, where they bake a blueberry pie using local fruit and a clever twist - infusing pastry with vanilla-tasting fig leaves, as the real thing won't grow on the island. Dessert comes first before Dermot heads inland to Broughgammon Farm. Here, husband-and-wife team Charlie and Becky are reshaping local food culture, championing goat meat and rose veal while giving value to male animals from the dairy industry. Dermot meets the animals and learns to cook the couple's favourite dish: schnitzel.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin's travels around France lead him to the beautiful lakeside town of Annecy, where he wanders around the market to select ingredients - on the stunning shore of Annecy's clear lake, James cooks dishes using delicious local tomatoes, red mullet, and lobster. World-famous cheesemonger Pierre Gay shows off his amazing selection of cheeses and inspires James to create a mouth-watering cheese and endive bake back in his home kitchen - James also meets local chef Yoann Conte, who has a passion for transforming simple local ingredients into something spectacular in his Michelin-starred restaurant. James's next stop is a visit to the award-winning pastry chef Philippe Rigollot to sample some of his extraordinary creations - drawing on his experiences in Annecy, James then makes a luxurious creme caramel back home in the UK.
